title: Conditional absolute moment as a coordinate projection
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite nonempty set with probability law $\pi$, let $n\ge 0$, let $f:\Omega^n\to\mathbb R$, and choose $p\in\mathbb R$, a coordinate $i\in\{1,\ldots,n\}$, and $x\in\Omega^n$. The $p$th absolute moment of $f$ about its mean when only coordinate $i$ is resampled according to $\pi$ equals the average, over that coordinate, of $|f-\mathbb E_i f|^p$, where $\mathbb E_i f$ denotes the same coordinate average of $f$ with all other coordinates fixed at $x$.
